views.definition:
SELECT p.canonical_product_id,
    p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    sc.sellable_configuration_id,
    sc.configuration_name,
    sc.normalized_key,
    sc.sort_order,
    sc.is_default_whole_product,
    sc.is_public_candidate,
    sc.review_status AS configuration_review_status,
    min(cp.public_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS min_price,
    max(cp.public_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS max_price,
    COALESCE(max(cp.source_currency) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))), 'USD'::text) AS currency,
    count(cp.configuration_price_id) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS public_price_row_count,
    bool_or(cp.fallback_flag) AS has_fallback_price,
    bool_or(cp.sampler_excluded_flag) AS has_sampler_excluded_price
   FROM ((feya_commerce_product_drafts p
     JOIN feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc ON ((sc.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_configuration_prices cp ON ((cp.sellable_configuration_id = sc.sellable_configuration_id)))
  WHERE ((sc.is_public_candidate = true) AND (sc.is_sampler = false))
  GROUP BY p.canonical_product_id, p.matched_etsy_listing_id, sc.sellable_configuration_id, sc.configuration_name, sc.normalized_key, sc.sort_order, sc.is_default_whole_product, sc.is_public_candidate, sc.review_status;

WITH base AS (
         SELECT v3.canonical_product_id,
            v3.product_slug,
            v3.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            v3.source_url,
            v3.card_title,
            v3.h1,
            v3.seo_title,
            v3.meta_description,
            v3.product_type,
            v3.material,
            v3.color,
            v3.size_mode,
            v3.production_profile,
            v3.shipping_profile,
            v3.handmade_flag,
            v3.styled_imagery_flag,
            v3.primary_image_url,
            v3.primary_image_alt,
            v3.secondary_image_url,
            v3.hover_image_url,
            v3.video_url,
            v3.has_video,
            v3.media_count,
            v3.media_gallery,
            v3.min_price AS v3_min_price,
            v3.max_price AS v3_max_price,
            v3.currency AS v3_currency,
            v3.has_fallback_price AS v3_has_fallback_price,
            v3.has_sampler_excluded_price AS v3_has_sampler_excluded_price,
            v3.storefront_candidate_flag
           FROM feya_commerce_v_step7_storefront_products_api_v3 v3
        ), raw_options AS (
         SELECT b_1.canonical_product_id,
            cp.configuration_price_id,
            cp.sellable_configuration_id,
            cp.source_price_row_id,
            cp.public_price_amount,
            cp.source_currency,
            cp.fallback_flag,
            cp.sampler_excluded_flag,
            cp.review_status AS configuration_price_review_status,
            cp.price_status,
            spr.price_source,
            spr.raw_option_name,
            spr.raw_option_value,
            spr.raw_option_text,
            spr.fallback_flag AS source_fallback_flag,
            spr.sampler_non_catalog_flag,
            spr.review_status AS source_review_status,
            sc.configuration_name,
            sc.normalized_key,
            sc.sort_order AS configuration_sort_order,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM spr.raw_option_value), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sc.configuration_name), ''::text), ''::text) AS raw_label,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM spr.raw_option_name), ''::text), 'Option'::text) AS raw_axis_label
           FROM (((base b_1
             JOIN feya_commerce_configuration_prices cp ON ((cp.canonical_product_id = b_1.canonical_product_id)))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc ON ((sc.sellable_configuration_id = cp.sellable_configuration_id)))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_source_price_rows spr ON ((spr.source_price_row_id = cp.source_price_row_id)))
          WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(cp.sampler_excluded_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(cp.fallback_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(spr.fallback_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(spr.sampler_non_catalog_flag, false) = false))
        ), label_mapped AS (
         SELECT ro.canonical_product_id,
            ro.configuration_price_id,
            ro.sellable_configuration_id,
            ro.source_price_row_id,
            ro.public_price_amount,
            ro.source_currency,
            ro.fallback_flag,
            ro.sampler_excluded_flag,
            ro.configuration_price_review_status,
            ro.price_status,
            ro.price_source,
            ro.raw_option_name,
            ro.raw_option_value,
            ro.raw_option_text,
            ro.source_fallback_flag,
            ro.sampler_non_catalog_flag,
            ro.source_review_status,
            ro.configuration_name,
            ro.normalized_key,
            ro.configuration_sort_order,
            ro.raw_label,
            ro.raw_axis_label,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(корсет[[:space:]]*\+[[:space:]]*бот|corset.*boot)'::text) THEN 'Corset + Boots'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(рога.*корсет|horns?.*corset)'::text) THEN 'Horns + Corset'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(плеч[ао]?.*брасл|shoulder.*bracelet)'::text) THEN 'Shoulder + Bracelet'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(пояс.*юбк|belt.*skirt)'::text) THEN 'Belt + Skirt'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(топ[[:space:]]*и[[:space:]]*юбк|top[[:space:]]*(and|\+)[[:space:]]*skirt)'::text) THEN 'Top + Skirt'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(пояс.*подвяз|belt.*garter)'::text) THEN 'Belt + Garters'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(бюстгальтер.*плеч|bra.*shoulder)'::text) THEN 'Bra + Shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(верх.*плеч|топ.*плеч|top.*shoulder)'::text) THEN 'Top + Shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(плеч.*юбк|shoulder.*skirt)'::text) THEN 'Shoulders + Skirt'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(верх.*шорт.*рукав|top.*short.*sleeve)'::text) THEN 'Top + Shorts + Sleeves'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(полный[[:space:]]*комплект|full[[:space:]]*set|complete[[:space:]]*set)'::text) THEN 'Full Set'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(наручи[[:space:]]*\*?[[:space:]]*2|arm[[:space:]]*guards?[[:space:]]*set)'::text) THEN 'Arm Guards Set'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(верхняя[[:space:]]*накидка|fabric[[:space:]]*cape)'::text) THEN 'Fabric Cape'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(нагрудн.*рем|chest[[:space:]]*harness)'::text) THEN 'Chest Harness'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(только[[:space:]]*топ|top[[:space:]]*only)'::text) THEN 'Top Only'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(только[[:space:]]*платье|dress[[:space:]]*only)'::text) THEN 'Dress Only'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(только[[:space:]]*юбк|skirt[[:space:]]*only)'::text) THEN 'Skirt Only'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(броня[[:space:]]*для[[:space:]]*ног|leg[[:space:]]*armor)'::text) THEN 'Leg Armor'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(броня[[:space:]]*для[[:space:]]*рук|arm[[:space:]]*armor)'::text) THEN 'Arm Armor'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(чехл.*для[[:space:]]*ног|leg[[:space:]]*covers?)'::text) THEN 'Leg Covers'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(наручи|нарукавник|arm[[:space:]]*guards?|arm[[:space:]]*covers?)'::text) THEN 'Arm Guards'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(корсет|corset)'::text) THEN 'Corset'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(воротник|collar)'::text) THEN 'Collar'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(рога|horns?)'::text) THEN 'Horns'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(трусик|panties|panty)'::text) THEN 'Panties'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(подвяз|garters?)'::text) THEN 'Garters'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(юбк|skirt)'::text) THEN 'Skirt'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(вершин|^топ$|[^[:alpha:]]топ[^[:alpha:]]|top)'::text) THEN 'Top'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(платье|dress)'::text) THEN 'Dress'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(маск|mask)'::text) THEN 'Mask'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(плеч|shoulder)'::text) THEN 'Shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(браслет|bracelet)'::text) THEN 'Bracelet'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(чокер|колье|necklace|choker)'::text) THEN 'Choker'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(боди|bodysuit|body[[:space:]]*suit)'::text) THEN 'Bodysuit'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(крыл|wings?)'::text) THEN 'Wings'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(пояс|belt)'::text) THEN 'Belt'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(ботин|boots?)'::text) THEN 'Boots'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(позвоночник|спина|spine|back)'::text) THEN 'Spine'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(хвост|tail)'::text) THEN 'Tail'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(перчат|gloves?)'::text) THEN 'Gloves'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(головн.*убор|корон|headpiece|crown)'::text) THEN 'Headpiece'::text
                    WHEN (ro.raw_label ~* '(шорт|shorts?)'::text) THEN 'Shorts'::text
                    ELSE 'Option'::text
                END AS public_label
           FROM raw_options ro
        ), componentized AS (
         SELECT lm.canonical_product_id,
            lm.configuration_price_id,
            lm.sellable_configuration_id,
            lm.source_price_row_id,
            lm.public_price_amount,
            lm.source_currency,
            lm.fallback_flag,
            lm.sampler_excluded_flag,
            lm.configuration_price_review_status,
            lm.price_status,
            lm.price_source,
            lm.raw_option_name,
            lm.raw_option_value,
            lm.raw_option_text,
            lm.source_fallback_flag,
            lm.sampler_non_catalog_flag,
            lm.source_review_status,
            lm.configuration_name,
            lm.normalized_key,
            lm.configuration_sort_order,
            lm.raw_label,
            lm.raw_axis_label,
            lm.public_label,
            (lm.public_label = 'Full Set'::text) AS is_full_set,
            (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Top + Skirt'::text, 'Shoulder + Bracelet'::text, 'Belt + Skirt'::text, 'Horns + Corset'::text, 'Corset + Boots'::text, 'Belt + Garters'::text, 'Bra + Shoulders'::text, 'Top + Shoulders'::text, 'Shoulders + Skirt'::text, 'Top + Shorts + Sleeves'::text])) AS is_bundle,
                CASE lm.public_label
                    WHEN 'Top + Skirt'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('top', 'skirt')
                    WHEN 'Shoulder + Bracelet'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('shoulders', 'bracelet')
                    WHEN 'Belt + Skirt'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('belt', 'skirt')
                    WHEN 'Horns + Corset'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('horns', 'corset')
                    WHEN 'Corset + Boots'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('corset', 'boots')
                    WHEN 'Belt + Garters'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('belt', 'garters')
                    WHEN 'Bra + Shoulders'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('top', 'shoulders')
                    WHEN 'Top + Shoulders'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('top', 'shoulders')
                    WHEN 'Shoulders + Skirt'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('shoulders', 'skirt')
                    WHEN 'Top + Shorts + Sleeves'::text THEN jsonb_build_array('top', 'shorts', 'sleeves')
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END AS bundle_component_codes,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Full Set'::text) THEN 'full_set'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Top + Skirt'::text, 'Shoulder + Bracelet'::text, 'Belt + Skirt'::text, 'Horns + Corset'::text, 'Corset + Boots'::text, 'Belt + Garters'::text, 'Bra + Shoulders'::text, 'Top + Shoulders'::text, 'Shoulders + Skirt'::text, 'Top + Shorts + Sleeves'::text])) THEN 'bundle'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Corset'::text) THEN 'corset'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Top'::text, 'Top Only'::text])) THEN 'top'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Dress'::text, 'Dress Only'::text])) THEN 'dress'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Skirt'::text, 'Skirt Only'::text])) THEN 'skirt'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Leg Covers'::text, 'Leg Armor'::text])) THEN 'legs'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Arm Guards'::text, 'Arm Guards Set'::text, 'Arm Armor'::text])) THEN 'arms'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Collar'::text) THEN 'collar'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Chest Harness'::text) THEN 'harness'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Horns'::text) THEN 'horns'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Belt'::text) THEN 'belt'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Boots'::text) THEN 'boots'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Panties'::text) THEN 'panties'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Garters'::text) THEN 'garters'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Choker'::text) THEN 'choker'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Bodysuit'::text) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Wings'::text) THEN 'wings'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Mask'::text) THEN 'mask'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Shoulders'::text) THEN 'shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Bracelet'::text) THEN 'bracelet'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Headpiece'::text) THEN 'headpiece'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Spine'::text) THEN 'spine'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Tail'::text) THEN 'tail'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Gloves'::text) THEN 'gloves'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Fabric Cape'::text) THEN 'cape'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Shorts'::text) THEN 'shorts'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS component_code,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Full Set'::text) THEN 'Bundle'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Top + Skirt'::text, 'Shoulder + Bracelet'::text, 'Belt + Skirt'::text, 'Horns + Corset'::text, 'Corset + Boots'::text, 'Belt + Garters'::text, 'Bra + Shoulders'::text, 'Top + Shoulders'::text, 'Shoulders + Skirt'::text, 'Top + Shorts + Sleeves'::text])) THEN 'Bundle'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Corset'::text, 'Top'::text, 'Top Only'::text])) THEN 'Top'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Dress'::text, 'Dress Only'::text])) THEN 'Dress'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Skirt'::text, 'Skirt Only'::text, 'Panties'::text, 'Shorts'::text])) THEN 'Bottom'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Leg Covers'::text, 'Leg Armor'::text, 'Garters'::text])) THEN 'Legs'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Arm Guards'::text, 'Arm Guards Set'::text, 'Arm Armor'::text, 'Bracelet'::text, 'Gloves'::text])) THEN 'Arms'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Collar'::text, 'Choker'::text])) THEN 'Neck'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Chest Harness'::text) THEN 'Harness'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Horns'::text, 'Headpiece'::text, 'Mask'::text])) THEN 'Headpiece'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Belt'::text) THEN 'Belt'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Boots'::text) THEN 'Shoes'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Bodysuit'::text) THEN 'Bodysuit'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Wings'::text) THEN 'Wings'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Shoulders'::text) THEN 'Shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = ANY (ARRAY['Spine'::text, 'Tail'::text])) THEN 'Back'::text
                    WHEN (lm.public_label = 'Fabric Cape'::text) THEN 'Cape'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS component_family,
            ((COALESCE(lm.raw_label, ''::text) ~ '[А-Яа-яЁё]'::text) OR (COALESCE(lm.raw_axis_label, ''::text) ~ '[А-Яа-яЁё]'::text)) AS has_russian_raw_label,
            ((lm.public_label = 'Option'::text) OR (lm.public_label ~ '[А-Яа-яЁё]'::text)) AS needs_label_review,
            false AS has_fallback_price,
            'source_option_text'::text AS price_source_mode,
            'unverified'::text AS price_confidence_status,
            lm.public_price_amount AS base_price_amount,
            lm.public_price_amount AS display_price_amount,
            NULL::numeric AS sale_price_amount,
            NULL::numeric AS compare_at_price_amount,
            NULL::numeric AS discount_percent
           FROM label_mapped lm
        ), ranked_options AS (
         SELECT c.canonical_product_id,
            c.configuration_price_id,
            c.sellable_configuration_id,
            c.source_price_row_id,
            c.public_price_amount,
            c.source_currency,
            c.fallback_flag,
            c.sampler_excluded_flag,
            c.configuration_price_review_status,
            c.price_status,
            c.price_source,
            c.raw_option_name,
            c.raw_option_value,
            c.raw_option_text,
            c.source_fallback_flag,
            c.sampler_non_catalog_flag,
            c.source_review_status,
            c.configuration_name,
            c.normalized_key,
            c.configuration_sort_order,
            c.raw_label,
            c.raw_axis_label,
            c.public_label,
            c.is_full_set,
            c.is_bundle,
            c.bundle_component_codes,
            c.component_code,
            c.component_family,
            c.has_russian_raw_label,
            c.needs_label_review,
            c.has_fallback_price,
            c.price_source_mode,
            c.price_confidence_status,
            c.base_price_amount,
            c.display_price_amount,
            c.sale_price_amount,
            c.compare_at_price_amount,
            c.discount_percent,
            (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.canonical_product_id ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN c.is_full_set THEN 900
                    WHEN c.is_bundle THEN 500
                    ELSE 100
                END, COALESCE(c.configuration_sort_order, 9999), c.display_price_amount, c.public_label, c.configuration_price_id))::integer AS v4_sort_order
           FROM componentized c
        ), configurations_agg AS (
         SELECT ranked_options.canonical_product_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS v4_configuration_count,
            bool_or(ranked_options.has_russian_raw_label) AS product_has_russian_raw_label,
            bool_or((ranked_options.public_label ~ '[А-Яа-яЁё]'::text)) AS product_has_russian_public_label,
            bool_or(ranked_options.needs_label_review) AS product_needs_label_review,
            bool_or(ranked_options.has_fallback_price) AS product_needs_price_review,
            min(ranked_options.display_price_amount) AS min_display_price_amount,
            max(ranked_options.display_price_amount) AS max_display_price_amount,
            min(ranked_options.source_currency) FILTER (WHERE (ranked_options.source_currency IS NOT NULL)) AS display_currency,
            min(ranked_options.display_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ranked_options.is_full_set) AS full_set_display_price_amount,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('configuration_id', (ranked_options.configuration_price_id)::text, 'sellable_configuration_id', (ranked_options.sellable_configuration_id)::text, 'public_label', ranked_options.public_label, 'component_code', ranked_options.component_code, 'component_family', ranked_options.component_family, 'is_full_set', ranked_options.is_full_set, 'is_bundle', ranked_options.is_bundle, 'bundle_component_codes', ranked_options.bundle_component_codes, 'base_price_amount', ranked_options.base_price_amount, 'sale_price_amount', ranked_options.sale_price_amount, 'compare_at_price_amount', ranked_options.compare_at_price_amount, 'display_price_amount', ranked_options.display_price_amount, 'discount_percent', ranked_options.discount_percent, 'currency', COALESCE(ranked_options.source_currency, 'EUR'::text), 'price_source_mode', ranked_options.price_source_mode, 'price_confidence_status', ranked_options.price_confidence_status, 'has_fallback_price', ranked_options.has_fallback_price, 'has_russian_raw_label', ranked_options.has_russian_raw_label, 'needs_label_review', ranked_options.needs_label_review, 'sort_order', ranked_options.v4_sort_order) ORDER BY ranked_options.v4_sort_order) AS configurations
           FROM ranked_options
          GROUP BY ranked_options.canonical_product_id
        ), component_floor AS (
         SELECT ranked_options.canonical_product_id,
            ranked_options.component_code,
            min(ranked_options.display_price_amount) AS component_min_price
           FROM ranked_options
          WHERE ((ranked_options.component_code IS NOT NULL) AND (ranked_options.component_code <> ALL (ARRAY['full_set'::text, 'bundle'::text])) AND (NOT ranked_options.is_full_set) AND (NOT ranked_options.is_bundle) AND (ranked_options.display_price_amount IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY ranked_options.canonical_product_id, ranked_options.component_code
        ), component_sums AS (
         SELECT component_floor.canonical_product_id,
            sum(component_floor.component_min_price) AS component_sum_display_price_amount
           FROM component_floor
          GROUP BY component_floor.canonical_product_id
        ), product_color AS (
         SELECT b_1.canonical_product_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.color, b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(gold|golden|золото|золот)'::text) THEN 'Gold'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.color, b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(silver|chrome|metallic|серебр|хром)'::text) THEN 'Silver'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.color, b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(black|dark|черн)'::text) THEN 'Black'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.color, b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(white|бел)'::text) THEN 'White'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.color, b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(red|красн)'::text) THEN 'Red'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.color, b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(holographic|hologram|iridescent)'::text) THEN 'Holographic'::text
                    WHEN ((NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM b_1.color), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (b_1.color !~ '[А-Яа-яЁё]'::text)) THEN initcap(TRIM(BOTH FROM b_1.color))
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS canonical_color_label
           FROM base b_1
        ), product_taxonomy AS (
         SELECT b_1.canonical_product_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(headpiece|crown|helmet|mask|horn)'::text) THEN 'Headpiece / Accessory'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(harness|belt|choker|collar)'::text) THEN 'Harness / Accessory'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(bodysuit|body suit)'::text) THEN 'Bodysuit'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(costume|outfit|set|wear)'::text) THEN 'Costume Set'::text
                    ELSE 'Performance Fashion'::text
                END AS category_label,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(burning man|desert)'::text) THEN 'Burning Man'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(rave|festival|edm)'::text) THEN 'Festival / Rave'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(cyber|futuristic|cosmic|alien|robot|chrome)'::text) THEN 'Cyber Futuristic'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(showgirl|stage|performance|dance)'::text) THEN 'Stage Performance'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b_1.card_title, ''::text) ~* '(goth|witch|halloween|dark)'::text) THEN 'Dark Fantasy'::text
                    ELSE 'TheFEYA Signature'::text
                END AS world_label
           FROM base b_1
        )
 SELECT b.canonical_product_id,
    b.product_slug,
    b.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    b.source_url,
    b.card_title,
    b.h1,
    b.seo_title,
    b.meta_description,
    b.product_type,
    b.material,
    b.color,
    b.size_mode,
    b.production_profile,
    b.shipping_profile,
    b.handmade_flag,
    b.styled_imagery_flag,
    b.primary_image_url,
    b.primary_image_alt,
    b.secondary_image_url,
    b.hover_image_url,
    b.video_url,
    b.has_video,
    b.media_count,
    b.media_gallery,
    COALESCE(ca.min_display_price_amount, b.v3_min_price) AS min_price,
    COALESCE(ca.max_display_price_amount, b.v3_max_price) AS max_price,
    COALESCE(ca.display_currency, b.v3_currency, 'EUR'::text) AS currency,
    b.storefront_candidate_flag,
    'v4_unverified'::text AS price_contract_version,
    'source_option_text'::text AS price_source_mode,
    'unverified'::text AS price_confidence_status,
    false AS has_unverified_discount,
    COALESCE(ca.product_has_russian_public_label, false) AS has_russian_public_label,
    (COALESCE(b.v3_has_fallback_price, false) OR COALESCE(ca.product_needs_price_review, false) OR (COALESCE(ca.v4_configuration_count, 0) = 0)) AS needs_price_review,
    COALESCE(ca.product_needs_label_review, false) AS needs_label_review,
    pt.category_label,
    pt.world_label,
    pc.canonical_color_label,
        CASE
            WHEN (pc.canonical_color_label IS NOT NULL) THEN jsonb_build_array(pc.canonical_color_label)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS color_options,
    ca.full_set_display_price_amount,
    cs.component_sum_display_price_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ca.full_set_display_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cs.component_sum_display_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cs.component_sum_display_price_amount > ca.full_set_display_price_amount)) THEN (cs.component_sum_display_price_amount - ca.full_set_display_price_amount)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS full_set_savings_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ca.full_set_display_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cs.component_sum_display_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cs.component_sum_display_price_amount > (0)::numeric) AND (cs.component_sum_display_price_amount > ca.full_set_display_price_amount)) THEN round((((cs.component_sum_display_price_amount - ca.full_set_display_price_amount) / cs.component_sum_display_price_amount) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS full_set_savings_percent,
    COALESCE(ca.configurations, '[]'::jsonb) AS configurations
   FROM ((((base b
     LEFT JOIN configurations_agg ca ON ((ca.canonical_product_id = b.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN component_sums cs ON ((cs.canonical_product_id = b.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_color pc ON ((pc.canonical_product_id = b.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_taxonomy pt ON ((pt.canonical_product_id = b.canonical_product_id)));
